methodology.checks: Independent task-by-task category/difficulty classification, wording review, canonical fact comparison, exact accepted-span slice validation, snapshot validation, resolver uniqueness, later-support exclusion, golden completeness, and cardinality review.
methodology.difficulty_standard: Category 1 is intentionally easy canonical one-edge retrieval. Category 2 adds one unique role/alias resolution but no meaningful traversal, temporal reasoning, update reconciliation, or unintended ambiguity.
methodology.transcript_hash_serialization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSONL through stream position 30: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, final newline.

requirement_assessments.evidence: Exactly 333 tasks exist; T001–T236 are JSON-object identical to v1, and every v2 task is bound to a concrete stream position.
333 = unchanged 236-task v1 prefix + 97 new tasks T237–T333. Additions are 17/16/16/16/16/16 for Day-0 categories 1–6.
Exactly 37 category-1 tasks overall and exactly 20 at after_day_0: 3 inherited plus T237–T253.
